notes.title: Best Friend is now launch!
notes.notes:
Best Friend is now available on Steam! This is my first game. I created this game alone. It may not be much fun, but I want you all to try it. Thanks for your interest. "Best Friend" is a 3D horror game. Escape and survive from your beloved doll named David after you don't have time to play with him. Follow the advice that David has told you, survive, and remember that you must never turn your back on David!

Bug Report: greatmonkeyth@gmail.com
Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/goodmonkeyth
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCC-8JlJR-fId-WQrYiTf3LA

notes.title: Best Friend is ready to launch!
notes.notes:
Best Friend is ready to launch this week. The game may disappoint some people because this is the first time that I make a PC horror game. I would like everyone to try playing this game and comments so we can improve and develop the work for the future. Thank you. Release date: May 6, 2020, on Steam.
